assumptions: USD million. Fictional Iris Ward. Toy payer pays per completed episode; quality bonus recognized only confirmed, readmission clawback reduces consideration. All signed settlements final.

evidence.text: [Episodes] 2,000 completed episodes at $40,000 each. 100 incomplete at year-end, no right to bill until completion; advance cash3m on incomplete episodes.
[Payer settlement] Confirmed readmission clawback5m, quality bonus2m confirmed and separately invoiced. Additional bonus4m disputed, not recognized.
[Cost] Completed episode expense55m, incomplete episode cost2m expensed, central expense12m, D&A3m, interest4m. No tax.
[AR] Opening billed AR8m, all earned consideration billed, ordinary cash collections70m including bonus receipts and net of clawback. No writeoff.
[Cash] Opening cash10m, completed/incomplete costs cash54m, central cash12m, interest4m. Equipment cash capex6m, no financing.
[Policy] Incomplete advance contract liability3, not earned; incomplete costs expensed. No balance offset.
[Deck] Uses 2,100×40k and full bonus6, calls 3 advance additional revenue and excludes incomplete episode cost.
[Quality] No risk-adjusted mortality or patient-level readmission rates; clawback amount is financial not clinical count.

qas.question: Tại sao 4 bonus disputed không đưa vào revenue hoặc AR?

qas.question: Có suy ra số readmissions bằng clawback5m chia episode price40k?

qas.answer: Không. Thiếu outcome, acuity và causal evidence.

assumptions: USD million. Fictional Reed Signal. Toy bundled phone/service contract allocation by relative standalone price; explicit interest separate from revenue. No tax.

evidence.text: [Bundle] 100k contracts Jan1; nominal service+device consideration $900 each excluding financing interest. Device standalone $600, 12-month service standalone $600. All delivered device Jan1, service delivered full year.
[Allocation] Relative SSP 50:50; device and service recognition separate. Explicit annual financing consideration6m earned as finance income, not service sales.
[Payment] Cash collected65m against principal consideration, 4m against interest. Opening AR zero, all rights unconditional, no writeoff.
[Cost] Device COGS40m, service cost20m, selling/admin15m, D&A5m. Interest expense3m. No other items.
[Credit] Closing gross receivable includes unpaid principal and interest; allowance 5% of both, initial allowance zero. Credit charge operating expense.
[Cash] All cost cash paid except D&A and credit charge, equipment capex8m. Opening cash20, borrowing cash10, no repayment.
[Metric] Monthly plan ARPU = allocated service revenue /100k/12. Device subsidy measured device standalone less allocated price, not extra current expense.
[Deck] Allocates device600 and service300 per customer, includes financing6 in service ARPU, expenses device subsidy again.

qas.answer: Không. Contract count không chứng minh unique subscriber identity.

qas.question: Có dự báo credit loss thực tế từ flat 5% allowance?
qas.answer: Không. Toy rate là assumption; thiếu individual aging, PD/LGD và future collections.
